name: Crossgrain
tagline: Trick-taking where the suit you must follow swings mid-trick, and everyone secretly farms one suit.
core_loop: Secretly pledge a grain suit, then follow the current suit or cut by matching the previous card's rank to swing it; the highest live card holds the 2-point grain token, and the trick winner harvests every live card at once for double value in their own pledged suit.
win_condition: Most points after one deal (two with 4 players): token and width points, harvested card values doubled in your pledged suit, a 3-point most-tricks bonus, a 3-point sheaf bonus for an honour of your suit and -2 blight for none; ties broken by tricks, then most recent trick, then lowest seat.
